ops.title: Metal VM memory: no-balloon ratchet, 32 GB sizing, nightly bounce
ops.body: macOS Virtualization.framework guests have no memory balloon: the VM service process's host footprint ratchets to the guest's high-water mark (the guest page cache fills all RAM within minutes of a model load) and only a VM restart clears it. The metal VM is sized 32 GB (packer/metal.pkr.hcl), deriving a ~26 GB GPU wired cap (hw.memsize - 6 GB, darwin/metal.nix) — fits one 35B model + KV cache, not two large models simultaneously. com.yclaw.metal-nightly-bounce stops the VM at 05:00; KeepAlive on com.yclaw.tart-metal relaunches it (32 GB -> ~9.4 GB verified). Resize procedure: guest shutdown -h now; launchctl bootout the runner; tart stop; tart set --memory <MiB>; launchctl bootstrap the runner plist.
ops.when: when resizing the metal VM, changing models in nixos/models.nix, touching VM lifecycle, or investigating high Virtualization.framework RSS
